title: BillingVibesPurchaseFromBalanceRequest
description: billing.vibes-purchase-from-balance-request@1: body of POST /api/me/vibes/from-balance (D12). Buys a whole number of Vibes with the signed-in person's Balance at the same Vibes price as a pack, charging exact nano-USD; Vibes -> Balance is never allowed. vibes is a whole integer (Vibes have no fractions); the money side is integer nano-USD (D1), never a float. idempotency_key makes the purchase exactly once.

vibes.description: How many whole Vibes to buy.

idempotency_key.description: Unique per mutation. A replay with the same key and body returns the first answer and changes nothing.
